text.title: Graph Design Record — Output Contract
text.summary: The artefact this methodology produces: a Graph Design Record (GDR) as YAML or JSON, machine-checkable by the bundled validator.

contract.field: What is being retrieved over, in one line.
The single strongest warrant from r1-graph-warrant. `none` is a valid, common and often correct answer.
Concrete evidence for the warrant, naming real nodes and edges in the data. "It feels connected" is not evidence.
The cheaper structure considered and why it loses. Required even when the warrant holds.
Measured mean query tokens of the CURRENT structure over ten real queries.
Measured or prototyped mean query tokens of the proposed graph over the SAME ten queries.
Closed enum. Each item: `name`, `direction`, `meaning`, `derived_from` (structural source) or `extracted_by` (model + reason derivation is impossible), and `temporal` (bool).
Maximum edges on one node before refactor is mandatory.
Computed sum of k^i for i in 0..h. Must be present and must be consistent with max_hops and max_fanout.
Declared ceiling the worst case must fit inside.
Deterministic score used when candidates exceed `k` — e.g. personalized PageRank seeded on query anchors, times edge weight, times recency decay.
Must contain all three of `referential`, `orphans`, `acyclicity`, each with the CI job that runs it.
What invalidates the graph and how it is rebuilt incrementally.

section.title: Stop condition
section.statement: When `warrant: none`, the record is COMPLETE at that field plus `warrant_evidence` and `rejected_alternative`. Every remaining field is omitted. A record that answers `none` and then specifies edge types has not understood the gate.

section.title: Consistency rules the validator enforces
section.statement: `worst_case_nodes` must equal the sum of `max_fanout`^i for i in 0..`max_hops`. `worst_case_nodes` multiplied by an assumed per-node cost must not exceed `context_budget_tokens`. Every edge type must declare exactly one of `derived_from` or `extracted_by`. If any edge type sets `temporal: true`, the warrant must be `temporal` or the record must justify the mismatch.
